items.question: How do I choose a roofing contractor in Columbus?

children.text: Look for a local headquarters, manufacturer certifications you can verify on the manufacturer's website, recent reviews from homeowners near you, an estimate that lists the materials and work included, and a clear workmanship warranty. Ask who your point of contact will be during the project.

items.question: Should I repair my roof or replace it?

children.text: It depends on the roof's age, how widespread the damage is, and whether leaks keep returning. A small problem on a roof with years left is usually a repair. Widespread wear, several leaks or a roof near the end of its life usually points to replacement. Our free inspection gives you a clear picture of the roof's condition before you decide.

items.question: Can you do my roof and siding at the same time?

children.text: Yes. Planning them together lets us coordinate flashing, trim and gutters where the roof meets the walls, and it keeps your project on one schedule with one team.
Yes. Roof inspections and estimates are free.

items.question: Can you help after a hail or windstorm?

children.text: Yes. We inspect for storm damage, document what we find, and explain the insurance process and your options. Whether to file a claim is your decision, and we'll give you clear information to make it.

items.question: How long will my project take?

children.text: It depends on the size of the home, the materials and the weather. Your quote lists the work included, and we'll confirm the schedule with you before work begins.
Yes. We offer 3-year and 5-year financing, with payments as low as $47 a month on qualifying projects.
